name: node-uio
description: Function blocks for the ModBee Node UIO board. Eight digital inputs and eight digital outputs, four analog inputs and two analog outputs with a per-channel range and two-point calibration, the HAT power switch, the network, sleep and wake, a controlled restart, hardware pulse counting for flow meters, I2C expansion modules, and the controller's own health for on-site diagnosis. Hardware only — no protocol is built in, so a protocol library runs alongside it rather than inside it.
